category: hosted integration platform (Connect API and MCP servers)

free_tier.stated: Free, no credit card required: every feature in development, with a daily credit limit and at most 10 external users
free_tier.notes: A credit is 30 seconds of compute; running an action, an MCP tool call, a Connect proxy request and a deployed-trigger emit each use credits, while listing and configuration calls do not. The daily number of free credits is unverified: the documentation names a daily limit without a number, and the figure is behind a sign-up. Unused daily credits do not roll over. Production use with real external users needs the Startup plan. Workflows takes no new sign-ups and shuts down on March 31, 2027; Connect is not affected.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the pages read

retention.stated: Workflows event history: 7 days of events on free tiers; Connect retention not stated on the pages read
retention.notes: All Workflows data is deleted by April 30, 2027.

egress.terms: not applicable: actions call third-party APIs; dedicated static egress IPs are on Business only

interface_detail: Connect SDKs and REST API at api.pipedream.com, MCP servers and the Connect proxy; the development environment is selected with an x-pd-environment header, and connecting an account in development needs a pipedream.com sign-in in the same browser.
tooling: the Connect SDKs and REST API, an MCP client against Pipedream MCP servers, and the Pipedream CLI
chaining: Supplies managed OAuth and prebuilt actions for 3,000+ APIs to a script or an agent working on the developer's own accounts, so it pairs with a scheduler or a compute host that runs the caller.

limits.value: a daily credit limit on free workspaces; the number is unverified (behind a sign-up)
10 external users in the development environment

limits_note: The production environment is not included on Free. Development mode is for the developer's own accounts. Workflows on free tiers time out at up to 300 seconds and test runtime is limited per day, but Workflows takes no new sign-ups.
binding_note: The daily credit cap binds first; the 10-user development limit matters only when serving others.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for a work email and a password, or Google or GitHub sign-in; the free plan needs no credit card.

reliability_note: Workflows is in maintenance mode with no new sign-ups and shuts down on March 31, 2027, with its data deleted by April 30, 2027; Connect is not affected.
confidence_note: Plan, environment limits, credit rules and the Workflows shutdown are read on first-party pages; the free daily credit number is not published and is behind a sign-up.
